title: Integrating Feature Understandability into Feature Selection for Human-Centred Tabular Explanations
abstract: arXiv:2610.16627v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Existing human-centred XAI research predominantly evaluates explanations after they have been generated. However, this fails to provide actionable insights into improving accessibility. This study incorporates human-based feature understandability into feature selection to improve the generation of human-centred explanations. Natural language explanations for machine learning models trained on tabular data often cite influential features in the input data to explain a given decision. As a consequence, users' ability to understand the produced explanation hinges on their understanding of the cited features. To quantify this natural-language feature understandability, Rossberg et al. proposed the Feature Understandability Scale, which assigns numerical `understandability scores' to features based on user feedback. translated_title: 将特征可理解性融入特征选择以实现以人为中心的表格数据解释
translated_abstract: 现有以人为中心的可解释人工智能（XAI）研究主要是在解释生成之后对其进行评估，然而这种方式无法为提升解释的可及性提供可操作的见解。本研究将基于人类的特征可理解性融入特征选择过程中，以改进以人为中心的解释的生成。针对在表格数据上训练的机器学习模型，自然语言解释通常会引用输入数据中有影响力的特征来解释某个给定决策，因此用户理解所生成解释的能力取决于他们对所引用特征的理解程度。为了量化这种自然语言特征可理解性，Rossberg 等人提出了特征可理解性量表，该量表基于用户反馈为特征分配数值化的“可理解性分数”。为了评估这些分数在多大程度上能够提升机器学习解释的质量，本研究收集了可理解性……
tldr: 本研究创新性地将基于用户反馈的特征可理解性分数融入特征选择过程，在解释生成之前就从源头上提升以人为中心的表格数据自然语言解释的质量。
en_tdlr: This study innovatively integrates human-based feature understandability scores into the feature selection process, improving the quality of human-centred natural language explanations for tabular machine learning models at the source, before explanations are even generated.
